text:
kai wong: kicking off customer Zeppelin LoRA bring-up. objective: int3 quant smoke + token stability + invoice formatting checks. will run compact quickpack and report.

kai wong: command: `tools/quickpack --model pegasus-13b --lora zeppelin_v1.safetensors --quant int3 --checks token_stability,invoice_format --out runs/zepp_qp2`

debra t: include the weird-prefix set (cases with '#INV', '# INV', ' #INV') and the currency edgecases (CUR:, CUR$, euro symbol). also add negative amounts and thousands separators.

omar s: heads-up: previous merge on customer had a tokenizer alias for '#INV' -> '#'+'INV'. we need to lock special tokens pre-merge or we will break downstream parsers.

eval-bot: run queued id=qp2-2024-11-14-09-9999; node p-qe-gpu-03. logs streaming to runs/zepp_qp2/log.txt

kai wong: initial quickpass (stage1) done: 5/9 checks failed. top failures: token split for '#INV', trailing zero drop for amounts, and a subtle whitespace insertion before currency symbol. sample: `expected: "#INV-009" got: "INV-009"` and `expected: "1,234.50" got: "1234.5"`.

debra t: that trailing zero issue smells like rounding/truncation in the postproc number formatter when it consumes decoded tokens. which quant rounding policy used?

omar s: quant pipeline used config `quant_profiles/int3_fast.json` which uses rounding=trunc and prune_mode=aggressive. also saw warnings: `WARN token alias: '#INV' collides -> aliasing id 50999 -> 30012`.

kai wong: proposed remediation: (1) apply vocab lock map with customer's original ids for protected tokens, (2) re-run merge with `--vocab-lock`, (3) set quant rounding to bankers and prune_mode conservative, (4) re-run quickpack. also add temp test that fails if any token from protected_tokens.txt is split post-merge.

debra t: +1. also capture token_diff JSON and attach to run artifacts for AE. helps debugging contract with customer.

eval-bot: re-run started qp2-2 id=qp2-2024-11-14-10-0200.

infra-bot: queued on p-qe-gpu-05, ETA ~5m.

eval-bot: re-run finished id=qp2-2024-11-14-10-0599. results: 8/9 pass. invoice tokens preserved, formatting fixed. remaining failure: small ROUGE-L regression on paraphrase set (-0.9 pts) for long-context examples (>1024). artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/zepp_qp2/run-1748810599/report.html and runs/zepp_qp2/token_diff.json

omar s: the ROUGE drop is likely quant-induced semantic smoothing on long contexts under int3. mitigation options: mixed-KV int8, or fall back to int4 for production. suggest a short perf/quality canary with mixed-KV on dedicated to measure tradeoffs.

debra t: agree. note: customers prefer correctness over a small latency gap. recommend mixed-KV canary. I'll flag support ticket and recommend dedicated trial.

kai wong: opening PR to add token-stability CI gate to merge-tool (fail on any protected token split) and set default prune_mode=conservative for customer merges. will link PR once ready.

eval-bot: advisory: int3 path shows slight CPU decode overhead at long context due to additional token handling; estimate +7% p95 decode for >2048.

kai wong: thanks all. marking quickpack resolved for now. scheduling dedicated canary next week (will attach artifacts to the customer ticket).

debra t: nice turnaround, thanks.
